labels.oneValuePerLine: One value per line; matching is case-sensitive.

tooltips.appliesWhen: Empty means all records of this entity type in the tenant. Select direct record fields: dropdowns, tags, checkboxes, links, or empty/filled values. Nonmatching fields are hidden and not required; stored values are preserved.
tooltips.requiredWhen: Require a valid value on every save when these conditions match, within the field's applicability scope. Stage-entry requirements are configured separately on each stage.
tooltips.isRequired: Always require a valid value on save when this field applies. Takes precedence over Required When.
tooltips.name: Machine name (no dots). Combined with the group name on create to form valueKey (e.g. city → address.city).
tooltips.valueKey: Immutable storage/template key. Email/WhatsApp use {{customFields.<valueKey>}} with dots nested for handlebars (address.city → customFields.address.city). Changing this after create is forbidden.
tooltips.isTemplateEnabled: When enabled, this field appears in Email Template and WhatsApp Campaign parameter pickers.
tooltips.options: Allowed values for enum / multiEnum types.
tooltips.defaultValue: Applied as a string default when the record has no value yet (type coercion happens in the UI).
tooltips.tenant: Derived automatically from teams or the parent group.
